public_theorems.name: ImbalancedChen.P2OriginalSaving16PullingFaceInduction.pull_row_subset
public_theorems.source_statement:
theorem pull_row_subset {m : Nat} (facet : Fin m → List Nat)
    (pivot : List Nat → Nat) (children : List Nat → List (List Nat))
    {n : Nat} {face row : List Nat}
    (hshape : Shape facet pivot children n face)
    (hrow : row ∈ pull pivot children n face) : row ⊆ face
public_theorems.scope: Given Shape for a face at finite fuel, every vertex of every row returned by pull on that face belongs to the face.

public_theorems.name: ImbalancedChen.P2OriginalSaving16PullingFaceInduction.evalQ_combine
public_theorems.source_statement:
theorem evalQ_combine (r s : ℚ) (a b : AffineRow) (x : QPoint) :
    evalQ (fun j => r * a j - s * b j) x =
      r * evalQ a x - s * evalQ b x
public_theorems.scope: Evaluation of a rational affine coefficient row formed as r·a − s·b equals r times evaluation of a minus s times evaluation of b.

public_theorems.name: ImbalancedChen.P2OriginalSaving16PullingFaceInduction.supporting_child
public_theorems.source_statement:
theorem supporting_child {m : Nat} (vertex : Nat → QPoint)
    (gate : Fin m → AffineRow) (facet : Fin m → List Nat) (whole face child : List Nat)
    (pivot : Nat) (hface : face ⊆ whole) (hp : pivot ∈ face)
    (hc : child ⊆ face) (hpc : pivot ∉ child)
    (hinc : ∃ g : Fin m, ∀ v ∈ face, (v ∈ child ↔ v ∈ facet g))
    (hnonneg : ∀ g v, v ∈ whole → 0 ≤ evalQ (gate g) (vertex v))
    (hfacet : ∀ g v, v ∈ whole → (v ∈ facet g ↔ evalQ (gate g) (vertex v) = 0)) :
    ∃ g : Fin m,
      0 < evalQ (gate g) (vertex pivot) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ child, evalQ (gate g) (vertex v) = 0) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ face, 0 ≤ evalQ (gate g) (vertex v)) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ face, v ∉ child → 0 < evalQ (gate g) (vertex v))
public_theorems.scope: Assuming a parent face in whole, an omitted pivot, facet incidence of the child, all-gate vertex nonnegativity and facet membership iff evaluation is zero, a gate is positive on the omitted pivot, zero on child vertices and nonnegative on the face, and positive on every face vertex outside the child.

public_theorems.name: ImbalancedChen.P2OriginalSaving16PullingFaceInduction.pull_pair_separated
public_theorems.source_statement:
theorem pull_pair_separated {m : Nat} (vertex : Nat → QPoint)
    (gate : Fin m → AffineRow) (facet : Fin m → List Nat)
    (whole : List Nat) (pivot : List Nat → Nat)
    (children : List Nat → List (List Nat))
    (hnonneg : ∀ g v, v ∈ whole → 0 ≤ evalQ (gate g) (vertex v))
    (hfacet : ∀ g v, v ∈ whole → (v ∈ facet g ↔ evalQ (gate g) (vertex v) = 0))
    {n : Nat} {face left right : List Nat}
    (hface : face ⊆ whole) (hshape : Shape facet pivot children n face)
    (hl : left ∈ pull pivot children n face)
    (hr : right ∈ pull pivot children n face) (hne : left ≠ right) :
    ∃ a : AffineRow,
      (∀ v ∈ left, evalQ a (vertex v) ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ right, 0 ≤ evalQ a (vertex v)) ∧
      ∃ v ∈ face, evalQ a (vertex v) ≠ 0
public_theorems.scope: Under whole-face containment, Shape, vertex nonnegativity of all gates and facet membership iff evaluation is zero, any two distinct generated rows admit an affine row nonpositive on left vertices, nonnegative on right vertices and nonzero at some parent-face vertex.

public_theorems.name: ImbalancedChen.P2Saving16Cell00OriginalPulling.cell00_original_face_incidence_shape
public_theorems.source_statement:
theorem cell00_original_face_incidence_shape :
    let c := archive (0 : Fin 14)
    let decodedFaces : Array FaceRecord :=
      (c.faceLedger.mapM decodeFace).toOption.getD #[]
    let record := fun (face : List Nat) =>
      (decodedFaces.toList.find? (fun f => f.vertices.toList == face)).getD default
    let pvt := fun (face : List Nat) => (record face).pivot
    let child := fun (face : List Nat) =>
      (((record face).facetSets.toList.map Array.toList).filter
        (fun candidate => !(candidate.contains (pvt face))))
    let facets := fun (f : Fin c.facetOriginalIndices.size) =>
      (c.facetVertices.getD f.val #[]).toList
    Shape facets pvt child 9 (List.range c.vertices.size)
public_theorems.scope: The original archive record at index 0 of Fin 14 satisfies finite Shape with the original facet-index list, decoded facet rows, face lookup, omitted-pivot child filter, and fuel nine on all its vertex indices.

public_theorems.name: ImbalancedChen.P2Saving16Cell00OriginalPulling.cell00_original_pulling_bindings
public_theorems.source_statement:
theorem cell00_original_pulling_bindings :
    let c := archive (0 : Fin 14)
    let decodedFaces : Array FaceRecord :=
      (c.faceLedger.mapM decodeFace).toOption.getD #[]
    let record := fun (face : List Nat) =>
      (decodedFaces.toList.find? (fun f => f.vertices.toList == face)).getD default
    let pvt := fun (face : List Nat) => (record face).pivot
    let child := fun (face : List Nat) =>
      (((record face).facetSets.toList.map Array.toList).filter
        (fun candidate => !(candidate.contains (pvt face))))
    let saved := c.simplices.toList.map (fun r => r.vertexIds.toList)
    pull pvt child 9 (List.range c.vertices.size) = saved ∧ saved.Nodup
public_theorems.scope: The original archive record at index 0 of Fin 14 has an ordered fuel-nine pull list equal to its saved simplex vertex-ID rows, and those saved rows have no duplicates.
